name: the-reveal
description: THE REVEAL — Discover the Vision. Interactive candidate campaign website and management platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @reveal/api" "npm run dev -w @reveal/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @reveal/api && npm run build -w @reveal/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
